idea.name: Remote cleaning business
idea.one_liner: Acquire residential cleaning customers, schedule recurring cleans, and subcontract the physical work to independent cleaners while keeping a share of each job.
idea.customer: Households seeking one-off or recurring cleaning.
idea.offer: Local home cleaning arranged and managed remotely, with independent cleaners completing the jobs.
idea.revenue_model: Customer pays for each clean; the operator retains a stated 50-60% of the job and pays the cleaner. Recurring bookings are encouraged.

key_quotes.quote: And it's called a remote cleaning business.

You can start a local cleaning company, but rather than doing all the physical work yourself, you build a system around the independent cleaners who are already skilled at doing this, and they just want more jobs.
You keep somewhere between 50 and 60% of every job that comes through, and the entire thing operates off of a laptop.

acquisition_channels.details: Post in local Facebook and Nextdoor groups as a person, introduce the cleaning company, and offer neighbors a discount.
Pay for leads or ads through Google LSA, Thumbtack, and Meta, including Facebook and Instagram ads.

ideas.delivery: The operator owns the customer relationship, books and coordinates jobs, and handles quality-control calls and occasional callbacks. Independent cleaners travel to homes and do the cleaning with their own equipment and transport.
